claims.claim: Every admissible7-primitive fibre is non-context-free with efficient fixed-label membership
claims.scope: All finite literal decimal words, including empty and leading zeros; each fixed admissible label. Not a theorem about RGphi state realizability.

claims.claim: Canonical and full fibre length series have the unit circle as a natural boundary
claims.scope: Integer coefficients, radius one and irrational support density; Parikh and Pólya–Carlson are classical checked inputs.

claims.claim: Finite-family prime-erasure fusion and exact uniform key-recovery criterion
claims.scope: Nonempty finite family of finite prime sets; recovery of K on8+9Z iff the common erased primes are contained in{3}; prefix ambiguity remains.

claims.claim: Exact finite-plus-periodic prefix ambiguity under a complete DFA
claims.scope: Fixed key and canonical word; orbit preperiod/period and acceptance residues, not necessarily the minimum Boolean period.

claims.claim: Unknown bounded length and regular-language rank/unrank attain the exact auxiliary-code bound
claims.scope: Exact h and length bound L; fixed-length minimax is reused fromR17M; new bounded count maximized byh=8, with no time-optimality claim.

claims.claim: Mean fixed per-fibre index cost is distinct from conditional entropy
claims.scope: Uniform words at each exact length; prior fibre law and entropy retained; new mean fixed-index cost with rigorous interval and geometric-tail checks.

claims.claim: Arbitrary unnormalized key modulus has effective resolution M/gcd(M,9)
claims.scope: Known exact length; consistency test included; complete-DFA count is pseudopolynomial in the numerical effective modulus.

claims.scope: Every nonempty fibre for a fixed prime; p=3 leavesK unchanged and gives regular prefix fibres. Formal transfer of the checked proofs, not a priority claim.
